title: More text models, more room for requests
summary:
Two more text models joined the API, Persian image prompts kept their characters, and 90-plus artistic styles found a place in the tutorials.

Added `claude-hybridspace`, backed by Claude 3.5 Haiku, and `qwen-coder`, backed by Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B. `llamalight` now uses Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, the text API limit rose from 40 to 200 requests per minute, and the 56,000-character input limit now applies only to `openai`.

Image prompt sanitization now preserves Persian and other non-Latin characters while removing control characters, so those prompts reach generation without losing their text.

The README and homepage tutorials now link an interactive book showing over 90 artistic styles made with Pollinations, with HTML and PDF versions.

highlights.title: Claude Hybridspace joins text
highlights.text: Use `claude-hybridspace` to send text requests to Claude 3.5 Haiku. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=claude-hybridspace).

highlights.title: Qwen Coder joins text
highlights.text: Use `qwen-coder` for text requests backed by Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen-coder).
